pages.text: Requires: $(li)8 flower pots [planted with wither roses] $(li)16 sculk blocks $(li)4 soul fires $(li)12 crying obsidian $(li)1 anvil $(li)1 smithing table $(li)1 blast furnace $(li)1 cauldron $(li)4 soul sand
An example of a properly built ritual.

The ritual must be performed in the $(item)Nether$(). Place a $(item)Soul Heart$() on the Dark Altar to forge the sword, or a $(item)Hunter's Bow$() to forge the bow. After activating it, a nearby $(bold)Apostle must be sacrificed$() before the ritual timer starts ticking.

Soul energy is drained from the $(item)Cursed Cage$() directly beneath the altar during the ritual: $(li)5,000 per second $(li)lasting 20 seconds $(li)100,000 in total $(br)$(bold)This cost is absolute; no amount of “Soul Discount” equipment will reduce it.
